name: CMX Gold & Silver Corp.
summary: CMX Gold & Silver Corp. functions as a junior mining enterprise, concentrating its efforts on the exploration and extraction of mineral resources throughout the United States. The company actively seeks out valuable deposits of silver, lead, copper, zinc, and gold. A cornerstone asset is its 100% ownership of the Clayton Silver mine, a property located in Custer County, Idaho. This site encompasses roughly 565 acres, comprising 29 patented claims, along with 6 unpatented mining claims that collectively cover 119 acres. Established in 1986, the company's main office is situated in Calgary, Canada. It previously operated as Liard Resources Ltd. before officially changing its name to CMX Gold & Silver Corp. in February 2011.
